text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 46 · 晨光里的王宫露台.
Environment:  An original fairy-tale castle terrace high above a green river valley, graceful ivory balustrade, wide open French doors, pale linen chaise, small rose planter and a cream stone stair curving down out of sight. Distant blue-gray turrets under a bright peach morning sky, soft atmosphere and open foreground. No people, statues, birds or coats of arms with animals.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 3 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit contact sheet: remove panel D because it mirrors the terrace. Keep panels A B C unchanged; arrange them as three equal landscape panels in one image, labeled A B C. Preserve chaise on left when looking out over river, stair opening on right, roses, warm sunrise. No people or animals.
